title: Pipe-cleaning robot
subtitle: Inspection, cleaning and maintenance
short: A cleaning robot concept for urban drainage pipes.
intro: Starting with manual drain-cleaning workflows, this concept combines pipe inspection, mechanical cleaning and high-pressure rinsing in a compact chassis to explore equipment that is easier to inspect and maintain.

facts.label: Scope
facts.value: Context research · Form and structure exploration · Drive system concept

facts.label: Recognition
facts.value: Finalist award, China–ASEAN Industrial Design Competition

facts.label: Stage
facts.value: Product concept; engineering performance requires prototype validation
